text:
Liam C: Hi everyone 1st day here1 On an M2 Pro running zsh. Followed the dotfiles bootstrap but stuck on a couple things: asdf plugins install fine but `asdf install python 3.11.6` fails during the build with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named '_ssl'`. Also the bootstrap script chowned some dotfiles to root for some reason (??). Any ideas?

Hannah B: Welcome! For the ssl issue make sure you have Xcode CLT and the brewed openssl dev libs: `xcode-select --install` then `brew install openssl@3 readline sqlite3 xz zlib`. Then try: `env LDFLAGS="-L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/lib" CPPFLAGS="-I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/include" pyenv install 3.11.6` (asdf uses pyenv under the hood for python).

Liam C: I did `xcode-select` already. Brew packages are installed. The build log still shows it falling back to system openssl and missing headers. Also my `~/.dotfiles/bootstrap` ended up owned by root after running the bootstrap script with sudo earlier facepalm.

Hannah B: Don't run bootstrap as root. `chown -R $USER:staff ~/.dotfiles` and re-run without sudo. We'll update the docs to warn about sudo. For the openssl headers, ensure `PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/lib/pkgconfig` is set in the shell where you run asdf install.

Liam C: Good catch, fixed perms. PKG_CONFIG_PATH made the build find openssl. Now a different snag: asdf nodejs plugin fails on `gpg: can't connect to the agent` during import-release-team-keyring. I'm behind a corp VPN/proxy.

Hannah B: For gpg issues on mac you can install `gpg` and `pinentry-mac` via brew and set `export GPG_TTY=$(tty)`. If the proxy blocks hkps, try `curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nodejs/node/master/pkg/keys/release-team.asc | gpg --import`. It's a bit handy but works.

Liam C: Hand-import worked. One more: direnv refuses to load `.envrc` complaining `layout asdf not found` even though `source ~/.asdf/asdf.zsh` is in .zshrc. I suspect order issues with dotfiles.

Hannah B: Make sure you source asdf before the direnv hook: in `~/.zshrc` put `export PATH="$HOME/.asdf/shims:$HOME/.asdf/bin:$PATH"` then `source ~/.asdf/asdf.zsh` then `eval "$(direnv hook zsh)"`. After that `direnv allow` should find `layout asdf`.

Liam C: That worked, thanks. Small policy q: the README suggests setting `RUSTFLAGS` and `CGO_ENABLED=1` globally. Should I add them to my shell rc or keep per-project?

Hannah B: Keep those per-project in `.envrc`. Global RUSTFLAGS can make builds non-reproducible across CI/colleagues. For Go we usually set `CGO_ENABLED=1` only when a repo needs native libs; put it in that repo's `.envrc`.

Liam C: Makes sense. Last: who to ping for dotfiles sync & 1Password new-hire vault? I forked the dotfiles but need the private scripts and the SSH key in 1Password.

Ops M: Ping @Ops M here or open an ops ticket. I'll add you to `redwood/new-hires/ssh` and create a PR to sync dotfiles if needed. Also ops-bot will create a ticket automatically if you post here.

devex-bot: Created ticket OPS-2354 to grant Liam C access to 1Password 'redwood/new-hires/ssh' and schedule dotfiles sync. :robot_face:

Liam C: Awesome 389 thanks everyone. Will re-run bootstrap without sudo and report back if anything else breaks. :thumbsup:
